A MESSAGE FROM ME TO YOU

Dear Jason, 💙

Thank you so much for being such a wonderful friend. Thank you for being there for me from the very beginning, since the day Nhyira gave me your number, up until now. Even when I kept referring to you as just a friend, you still accepted me and continued being there for me. Your everyday “hi's,” good mornings and good nights may seem like little things, but they mean a lot to me. I truly appreciate you, Jason. Thank you for being such a special friend. I hope this new year of your life brings you happiness, success and beautiful memories.

Thank you for being a special friend.
